place.name: Dominican Church, Lviv
place.description: The Dominican Church and Monastery (Ukrainian: Домініканський костел і монастир, romanized: Dominikanskyi kostel i monastyr, Polish: Kościół i klasztor Dominikanów we Lwowie) in Lviv, Ukraine is located in the city's Old Town, east of the market square. It was originally built as the Roman Catholic Church of Corpus Christi, and today serves as the Greek Catholic Church of the Holy Eucharist.
